column1: # Blasphemous 2 (Switch, update 1.0.8 = v524288). Opening gameplay tested on the Mac.
# Unity 2021.3.20f1 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 15.3.2, NVN. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# NPDM: 16 MB of system resource, virtual address memory. No heap is set in the Mac check.
# With the hardware pool, StandardAllocator and Unity's own regions reach +4.26 GB of the
# 4.375 GB alias region during startup. The 1 GB pool leaves room for Unity's separate regions,
# as in the other Unity profiles. The SDK-wide node-area and size-class alignment patches apply.
# Unity Shader objects in the player's serialized files and Addressables bundles, plus
# the player's eleven GLSLC outputs in main. All sources live under Data/.
